segments.he:
תּוֹרָה עד
פּוּרִים הוּא הֲכָנָה לְפֶסַח. עַל־יְדֵי מִצְווֹת שֶׁל פּוּרִים שֶׁמְּקַיְּמִים, זוֹכִים לִהְיוֹת נִשְׁמָרִים מֵחָמֵץ בְּפֶסַח:
segments.en: The very looking at the faces of Tzadikim alone is a very great matter. Certainly when one merits to speak with him — it is even better. But even the looking alone is very good and is very beneficial for holiness.
